subject: Request: Timeboxed no-PO onboarding & evidence gating for ArborLytics pilot
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@arborlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arborlytics.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — ask for temporary no-PO path

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to kick off a 6-week pilot with Redwood across two product teams (search and ingestion). Legal/finance here at ArborLytics are asking for our standard procurement flow, but given the short pilot window they asked whether Redwood can accept a temporary "no-PO" onboarding for the pilot so we can get engineers access this week.

Key points:
- Pilot value: ~USD 18k over 6 weeks (estimated token spend).
- Goal: lower friction so teams can validate integration before procurement completes.
- We can provide a purchase order after pilot if both sides decide to go to paid production.

What we need from you: confirmation on whether Redwood has an internal temporary exemption process, minimum controls you need (evidence, limits, invoices), and who to route the paperwork to. I’ve attached a short SOW and our vendor intake snapshot.

Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Integrations, ArborLytics
sam@arborlytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: ArborLytics_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, vendor_onboarding_snapshot.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@arborlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — ask for temporary no-PO path

Sam — thanks for the SOW and for the clear ask. Short answer: we do have a timeboxed exemption path we can use for small pilots, but it requires a few gating controls from the vendor side and internal approvals on our end. I’m looping Marissa (Sales Ops/legal lead) and Jonas (Procurement) to outline the exact evidence & spend caps we’ll need.

High level controls we usually require:
- Spend cap set in the account (we can enforce a $20k cap for the pilot).
- Vendor onboarding form completed (basic tax/W-9 or W-8, billing contact).
- Evidence of company identity and a point-of-contact for invoices.
- Timebox: temporary exemption for up to 60 days; extension requires review.
- Auditability: vendor agrees to invoice within 30 days of pilot end and to the standard Redwood payment terms for the PO once issued.

If you’re comfortable with those, Marissa/Jonas will send an internal temporary-exemption form to sign and a short checklist.

Karthik
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

On the attachments: I downloaded your SOW — looks good and concise.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@arborlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — ask for temporary no-PO path

Hi Sam — welcome, and appreciate the clear SOW. A few clarifying items from a controls perspective so we can move quickly:

1) Evidence package (we can accept these scanned):
   - Completed vendor_onboarding_snapshot.xlsx (thank you for sending an initial copy)
   - Form W-9 or W-8 (depending on US status) OR equivalent tax registration docs
   - Proof of company registration (incorporation or VAT registration)

2) Governance on the exemption:
   - Proposed timebox: 60 days from activation.
   - Max spend cap: $20,000 hard cap enforced at account level.
   - Extension process: request + justification 10 business days before expiration; requires Procurement + Finance sign-off.

3) Billing & invoicing:
   - Send invoices to finance@arborlytics.com cc: procurement@arborlytics.com and copy laura_bennett@redwood.com so we can reconcile.
   - Redwood will issue usage reports weekly to the POC during the pilot.

4) Security/compliance note: for pilot access to non-production models we’ll require the ArborLytics integration to use our sandbox tokens and not send sensitive customer PII during the pilot. If you expect to use production data, we’ll need a short justification and tighter controls.

I’ve attached our temporary-no-po-exemption-form.pdf — please complete & return the vendor fields and tax docs. Once we have that, Jonas will provision the spend cap and open the account.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: temporary-no-po-exemption-form.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam@arborlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — ask for temporary no-PO path

Thanks all — operational notes from Procurement:

- Once we receive the completed temporary-no-po-exemption-form and a W-9/W-8, Procurement will create a vendor stub and activate the spend cap (we typically enforce caps via account-level throttles).
- We will set automated billing alerts to both vendor and Redwood finance at $10k and $18k to avoid surprise runouts.
- Please confirm whether the pilot will be split across two sub-accounts or one account with project tags — splitting helps enforcement and makes post-pilot invoicing simpler.

One additional ask: because this is a no-PO exception, Procurement requires an internal sponsor sign-off (Revenue owner or Product lead). Karthik — can you add the internal sponsor and confirm the sub-account mapping?

Jonas Weber
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Sam Patel <sam@arborlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — ask for temporary no-PO path

Marissa/Jonas — thanks, that process works for us. A few quick confirmations from our side:

- We will complete the temporary-no-po-exemption-form today and attach a scanned W-9.
- Pilot will run under two sub-accounts (search-team and ingestion-team). I’ll provide the billing contact for invoices (finance@arborlytics.com) and the internal sponsor is Priya Rao, VP Product (priya.rao@arborlytics.com).
- We agree to the $20k cap and the 60-day timebox.
- We’ll use sandbox tokens and limit data to synthetic/test payloads until we sign a production PO.

Please send the DocuSign envelope or confirm the return email for the completed form and we’ll get it signed. Looking forward to getting started.

Sam
